Package com.solace.connectors.tracing.internal

Class SolaceConnectionProvider

java.lang.Object
com.solace.connectors.tracing.internal.SolaceConnectionProvider
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.mule.runtime.api.connection.CachedConnectionProvider<SolaceConnection>, org.mule.runtime.api.connection.ConnectionProvider<SolaceConnection>
@Alias("connection") public class SolaceConnectionProvider extends Object implements org.mule.runtime.api.connection.CachedConnectionProvider<SolaceConnection>
Connects with the Solace JMS API directly (no JNDI). The Solace API retries and reconnects on its own; only when its retries are exhausted does Mule's reconnection strategy take over.
